integrity: The matrix definitions, finite all-rule decision, 256-row denominator polynomial table and two verification programs with captured outputs are complete and reproducible. Calculations are computer-assisted and have not received independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only primitive temporal period-two configurations on finite cyclic rings; the six-site cutoff is certified by exhaustive exact analysis of the 256 elementary rules and a sixteen-state strongly connected component criterion. Not a theorem for nonspatially-periodic bi-infinite configurations or longer temporal periods. Originality qualified by possible previously unindexed tables and the incomplete full-text access to the Automata 2015 conference paper.
title: A sharp six-site test and forty temporal-two zeta classes for elementary cellular automata
